dedupe_keys.name: idena navarra es cycling and walking datasets

description: idena.navarra.es: cycling and walking datasets is a collection of datasets listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idena.navarra.es. Coverage: the area served by idena.navarra.es. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about cycling and walking; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Movilidad ciclista. Aparcamientos para bicicletas; Movilidad ciclista. Servicios accesibles a usuarios de bicicletas; Movilidad ciclista. Señalización vertical ciclista; Movilidad ciclista. Red de movilidad ciclista. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
